notes: Customer: AgentMesh is a multi-tenant agent orchestration platform for mid-market SaaS customers.
Primary ask: start on Hosted API for fast rollout, move to Dedicated once steady-state usage + billing per-tenant is needed.
Workload: chat/agent workloads with heavy streaming + external tool calls (webhook actions, DB lookups).
Latency SLOs: target p50 <100ms for streaming segments, p95 <250-350ms depending on tool-call fanout — they flagged p99 concerns.
Throughput targets: emulate 200 RPS across tenants during peak; expected steady 40-60 RPS typical.
Rate limits: want per-tenant quotas + burst allowance; also usage attribution to charge customers per-tenant-token usage.
Streaming stability: saw reconnects during POC on 30+ minute sessions; customer: "\"stream drops are the dealbreaker\"" , wants retries & resume support.
Tool calling: complex flows where one user session triggers 3-6 tool calls which amplify latency — need circuit-breakers/fallbacks.
Security: must support SSO/SAML, audit logs per-tenant, KMS integration for customer-managed keys (future), SOC2 compliance.
Quote from CTO: 'If streaming can't meet SLOs under our multi-tenant profile, we can't go live.'
Sales ask: produce cost model for hosted -> dedicated migration + example committed commit sizes and breakpoints.
SE notes: suggest batch window tuning + per-tenant routing to reduce cross-tenant contention; consider KV prefix caching for repeated prompts.
Next: deliver POC perf report, proposed Dedicated config and pricing tiers, legal/security pack for procurement.
